description: A photograph depicting a volcanic landscape in the Canary Islands, characterised by barren, rocky terrain under a clear blue sky. The foreground shows reddish-brown bare ground composed of volcanic ash and debris. In the midground, a prominent conical hill with reddish-brown slopes, likely a volcanic cone, is visible. To the left of this cone, dark, undulating ground suggests barren lava fields, through which a winding road or path can be seen. In the background, a larger, dark mountain, consistent with a main volcanic peak, shows some subtle lighter green patches indicating minimal vegetation. The scene aligns with the definition of "bare rocks, outcrops, cliffs and scree" due to the presence of volcanic activities and very little high vegetation.
